Variable
Default Value
Description + Effect + Scenario




OLLAMA_HOST
"http://127.0.0.1:11434"
Configures the host and scheme for the Ollama server. Effect: Determines the URL used for connecting to the Ollama server. Scenario: Useful when deploying Ollama in a distributed environment or when you need to expose the service on a specific network interface.


OLLAMA_ORIGINS
[localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0] + app://, file://, tauri://
Configures allowed origins for CORS. Effect: Controls which origins are allowed to make requests to the Ollama server. Scenario: Critical when integrating Ollama with web applications to prevent unauthorized access from different domains.


OLLAMA_MODELS
$HOME/.ollama/models
Sets the path to the models directory. Effect: Determines where model files are stored and loaded from. Scenario: Useful for managing disk space on different drives or setting up shared model repositories in multi-user environments.


OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE
5 minutes
Sets how long models stay loaded in memory. Effect: Controls the duration models remain in memory after use. Scenario: Longer durations improve response times for frequent queries but increase memory usage. Shorter durations free up resources but may increase initial response times.


OLLAMA_DEBUG
false
Enables additional debug information. Effect: Increases verbosity of logging and debugging output. Scenario: Invaluable for troubleshooting issues or understanding the system's behavior during development or deployment.


OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION
false
Enables experimental flash attention feature. Effect: Activates an experimental optimization for attention mechanisms. Scenario: Can potentially improve performance on compatible hardware but may introduce instability.


OLLAMA_NOHISTORY
false
Disables readline history. Effect: Prevents command history from being saved. Scenario: Useful in security-sensitive environments where command history should not be persisted.


OLLAMA_NOPRUNE
false
Disables pruning of model blobs on startup. Effect: Keeps all model blobs, potentially increasing disk usage. Scenario: Helpful when you need to maintain all model versions for compatibility or rollback purposes.


OLLAMA_SCHED_SPREAD
false
Allows scheduling models across all GPUs. Effect: Enables multi-GPU usage for model inference. Scenario: Beneficial in high-performance computing environments with multiple GPUs to maximize hardware utilization.


OLLAMA_INTEL_GPU
false
Enables experimental Intel GPU detection. Effect: Allows usage of Intel GPUs for model inference. Scenario: Useful for organizations leveraging Intel GPU hardware for AI workloads.


OLLAMA_LLM_LIBRARY
"" (auto-detect)
Sets the LLM library to use. Effect: Overrides automatic detection of LLM library. Scenario: Useful when you need to force a specific library version or implementation for compatibility or performance reasons.


OLLAMA_TMPDIR
System default temp directory
Sets the location for temporary files. Effect: Determines where temporary files are stored. Scenario: Important for managing I/O performance or when system temp directory has limited space.


CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
All available
Sets which NVIDIA devices are visible. Effect: Controls which NVIDIA GPUs can be used. Scenario: Critical for managing GPU allocation in multi-user or multi-process environments.


HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES
All available
Sets which AMD devices are visible. Effect: Controls which AMD GPUs can be used. Scenario: Similar to CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES but for AMD hardware.


OLLAMA_RUNNERS_DIR
System-dependent
Sets the location for runners. Effect: Determines where runner executables are located. Scenario: Important for custom deployments or when runners need to be isolated from the main application.


OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
0 (unlimited)
Sets the number of parallel model requests. Effect: Controls concurrency of model inference. Scenario: Critical for managing system load and ensuring responsiveness in high-traffic environments.


OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS
0 (unlimited)
Sets the maximum number of loaded models. Effect: Limits the number of models that can be simultaneously loaded. Scenario: Helps manage memory usage in environments with limited resources or many different models.


OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE
512
Sets the maximum number of queued requests. Effect: Limits the size of the request queue. Scenario: Prevents system overload during traffic spikes and ensures timely processing of requests.


OLLAMA_MAX_VRAM
0 (unlimited)
Sets a maximum VRAM override in bytes. Effect: Limits the amount of VRAM that can be used. Scenario: Useful in shared GPU environments to prevent a single process from monopolizing GPU memory.

"""
A FastAPI proxy server for routing embedding requests to various AI vendors.

This proxy acts as a unified endpoint for different embedding services.
Clients can specify the desired vendor in the request URL, and the proxy
forwards the request to the appropriate vendor's API, handling authentication
and returning the vendor's response.
"""

import httpx, json
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, Response, HTTPException, status
from litellm import acompletion, model_list

# print(model_list)
# --- Configuration ---
# Mapping of vendor names to their target API endpoints.
# This allows the proxy to be easily extended for new services.
VENDOR_URLS = {
    # first-party

    "xai": "https://api.x.ai/v1",

    "aws": "https://runtime.sagemaker.{region}.amazonaws.com/endpoints/{endpoint_name}/invocations",
    "bedrock": "https://bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/model/{model_id}/invoke",
    "ibm": "https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/generation",

    This endpoint dynamically generates the list of models by iterating through

        ],
        "object": "list",
    }


@app.post("/v1/{vendor}/embeddings")
async def proxy_embeddings_request(vendor: str, request: Request):
    """
    Proxies an embedding request to a specified vendor.

    This endpoint receives an embedding request, determines the target vendor
    from the URL, and forwards the request with the original headers and body.

    Args:
        vendor: The name of the AI vendor (e.g., 'openai', 'deepinfra').
        request: The incoming FastAPI request object.

    Raises:
        HTTPException:
            - 404 Not Found: If the specified vendor is not supported.
            - 401 Unauthorized: If the Authorization header is missing.
            - 503 Service Unavailable: If there's an error communicating with the vendor.
            - 500 Internal Server Error: For any other unexpected errors.

    Returns:
        A FastAPI Response object containing the content, status code, and
        headers from the vendor's response.
    """
    target_url = VENDOR_URLS.get(vendor)
    if not target_url:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=f"Vendor '{vendor}' is not supported.")

    authorization_header = request.headers.get("authorization")
    if not authorization_header:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Authorization header is missing.")

    request_body = await request.json()
    if vendor == "deepinfra":
        # DeepInfra requires the encoding_format to be specified for some models
        request_body["encoding_format"] = "float"
    elif vendor == "voyageai":
        # VoyageAI requires input_type to be specified
        if "input_type" not in request_body:
            request_body["input_type"] = "document"

    headers_to_forward = {
        "Authorization": authorization_header,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }

    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        try:
            response = await client.post(target_url, headers=headers_to_forward, json=request_body, timeout=60.0)
            return Response(content=response.content, status_code=response.status_code, headers=dict(response.headers))
        except httpx.RequestError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, detail=f"An error occurred while communicating with the vendor: {exc}")
        except Exception as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, detail=f"An unexpected error occurred: {exc}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn

    print("Starting proxy server on http://0.0.0.0:9001")
    # The string "custom_openai_proxy:app" tells uvicorn where to find the FastAPI instance.
    # reload=True is great for development as it automatically restarts on code changes.
    uvicorn.run("custom_openai_proxy:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=9001, reload=True)

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional


class SuggestItem(BaseModel):
    """
    Represents a suggested answer for the ask_followup_question tool.
    The text is the suggested answer, and mode is an optional attribute
    to specify a mode switch.
    """
    text: str = Field(..., description="The suggested answer text.")
    mode: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional mode to switch to when this suggestion is selected.")


class AskFollowupQuestion(BaseModel):
    """
    Model for the ask_followup_question tool.
    Asks the user a question with suggested answers.
    """
    question: str = Field(..., description="The question to ask the user.")
    follow_up: List[SuggestItem] = Field(..., description="A list of 2-4 suggested answers.")


class AttemptCompletion(BaseModel):
    """
    Model for the attempt_completion tool.
    Presents the final result of a task.
    """
    result: str = Field(..., description="The final result of the task.")


class SwitchMode(BaseModel):
    """
    Model for the switch_mode tool.
    Requests to switch to a different mode.
    """
    mode_slug: str = Field(..., description="The slug of the mode to switch to (e.g., 'code', 'ask', 'architect').")
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The reason for switching modes.")


class NewTask(BaseModel):
    """
    Model for the new_task tool.
    Creates a new task instance in a chosen mode.
    """
    mode: str = Field(..., description="The slug of the mode to start the new task in (e.g., 'code', 'debug', 'architect').")
    message: str = Field(..., description="The initial user message or instructions for this new task.")


class UpdateTodoList(BaseModel):
    """
    Model for the update_todo_list tool.
    Replaces the entire TODO list with an updated checklist.
    The 'todos' field represents the full markdown checklist string.
    """
    todos: str = Field(..., description="The full markdown formatted checklist string to replace the current list.")


# Additional models for the second file's tools
class ReadFileArgsFile(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="File path (relative to workspace directory c:\\Github\\SwamixGlobal)")


class ReadFileArgs(BaseModel):
    file: List[ReadFileArgsFile]


class ReadFile(BaseModel):
    args: ReadFileArgs


class FetchInstructions(BaseModel):
    task: str = Field(..., description="The task to get instructions for (e.g., 'create_mcp_server', 'create_mode')")


class SearchFiles(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="The path of the directory to search in (relative to the current workspace directory)")
    regex: str = Field(..., description="The regular expression pattern to search for")
    file_pattern: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Glob pattern to filter files (e.g., '*.ts')")


class ListFiles(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="The path of the directory to list contents for (relative to the current workspace directory)")
    recursive: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Whether to list files recursively")


class ListCodeDefinitionNames(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="The path of the file or directory to analyze (relative to the current working directory)")


class ApplyDiffDiffBlock(BaseModel):
    start_line: int = Field(..., description="The line number of original content where the search block starts.")
    search_content: str = Field(..., description="Exact content to find including whitespace")
    replace_content: str = Field(..., description="New content to replace with")


class ApplyDiff(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="The path of the file to modify (relative to the current workspace directory)")
    diff: List[ApplyDiffDiffBlock] = Field(..., description="List of search/replace blocks defining the changes")


class WriteToFile(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="The path of the file to write to (relative to the current workspace directory)")
    content: str = Field(..., description="The complete content to write to the file")
    line_count: int = Field(..., description="The number of lines in the file")


class InsertContent(BaseModel):
    path: str = Field(..., description="File path relative to workspace directory")
    line: int = Field(..., description="Line number where content will be inserted (1-based). Use 0 to append at end.")

class SearchAndReplace(BaseModel):

    ignore_case: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Set to true to ignore case when matching")


class ExecuteCommand(BaseModel):
